positions.title: Integrations Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Developed an automated process for ASM's global survey distribution program to notify venue administrators in real-time of errors in their customer contact file submissions. Led to a 85% reduction in time for admins to correct errors and successfully distribute surveys to their event customers. 

• Built an Azure Databricks pipeline to extract data from a 3rd party system containing survey responses from attendees of Ticketmaster events at US venues and ingest it into our warehouse. Enabled our BI team to generate reports on this data for the first time; used to enhance the fan experience for 100k+ fans.

• Took initiative to satisfy data requests for our Marketing team using complex SQL queries on tables of up to 30M records, leading to targeted customer marketing and sale of thousands of additional concert tickets.

positions.title: Senior CX Technology Consultant
positions.description:
• Technical lead for end-to-end implementations of Experience Management (XM) software for Enterprise and Federal clients.

• Saved 100+ hours of manual work by building Python scripts leveraging the Qualtrics public API to automate client tasks, such as editing survey data and bulk importing survey responses.

• Led the design of a custom closed-loop API project, resulting in a 15% increase in new development revenue for the Engineering Services team.

• Served as primary point of contact for client web development teams for management of Qualtrics JavaScript code injected on their site to provide digital touchpoints to their users.

• Maintained detailed project plans, lead User Acceptance Testing efforts, and drove product escalations and feature requests with Engineering teams.

positions.title: Senior Product Specialist
positions.description:
• Supported and trained end-users in core competencies for customer experience programs for our entire client base, including Fortune 500 company program leaders, small business owners and professors.

• Specialized in 6 different Qualtrics product offerings, focusing on our CX suite that included Dashboard Reporting, API and Website/App Feedback.

• Spearheaded initiative with Global Operations Managers to improve our onboarding process. Reduced the time needed for our new Product Specialists to learn the product and feel comfortable to begin engaging with customers by 15%.

positions.title: Undergraduate Researcher
positions.description:
• Successfully developed an algorithm using C++ to provide accurate pointing information for supernova neutrinos detected in water-Cherenkov detectors.

• Implemented techniques from vector and linear algebra in code using ROOT and C++ to recreate electron scattering distributions. Simulated 1000's of events using my algorithm to produce plots to compare to the BONSAI fitter, a known fitting program for neutrino events, achieving 97% accuracy in reconstructing neutrino distributions.

• Frequently used Mac OS Unix command line for creating/moving/copying files, running scripts and for making SSH connections into the Physics Department server for writing code and accessing data.

• Wrote scripts to use HTCondor to run parallel computing jobs on clusters.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
• Tutored students in introductory mechanics and introductory electricity and magnetism, leading discussions of up to 20 students in multiple office hours each week.

• Engaged in individualized discussions with students to walk them through specific concepts and worked examples on the board.

honors.title: 1st Place at Blueprint Conservation Tech Ideation Conference
honors.description: My project team was awarded with 1st place for best project idea for our interdisciplinary and high-tech approach to solving complex environmental issues at Duke Blueprint, a sustainable tech ideation conference. Pitched our project, a innovative modular farm designed for harvesting seaweed to supplement cattle feed to reduce their methane emissions by up to 70-80%, in two separate, short presentations in front of organizations such as P&G, World Wildlife Fund and Conservation X Labs.
honors.issuer: Issued by Duke Conservation Tech · Feb 2018

volunteerExperiences.description:
- Organized tours and group discussions to help acclimate incoming first year students to Duke's campus and introduce them to the opportunities that Duke has to offer. 
- Led personal discussions on sensitive issues with students of diverse backgrounds and personalities. 
- Required to be knowledgeable of all the opportunities Duke offered regarding academics, athletics, extracurriculars, etc. to adequately answer the multitude of questions the new students had. 
- Underwent a week long training program to allow me to effectively lead these personal discussions, adapt to different situations with the students and to make them feel welcome and comfortable in the college environment.

- Worked with Duke Climate Coalition to postpone, and eventually dismantle, Duke University's proposal for a Combined Heat and Power natural gas plant. 
- Petitioned for photos and signatures from Duke students and Durham community locals
- Organized meetings for text banking and data entry to contact various people and environmental groups/schools in North Carolina to educate them on the plant

projects.title: Genomic Annotation Service
projects.description:
- Developed a distributed microservice based bioinformatic annotation system for users to submit and track annotation jobs.
- Implemented EC2 hosted frontend and backend services, leveraging autoscaling groups with ELB to ensure high availability and scalability.
- Leveraged DynamoDB, Glacier and S3 for data storage, Lambda for real-time user notifications, and SNS/SQS for async inter-service communication.

projects.title: Timepiece Trader
projects.description:
- Project lead for 6 member team building an auction system for users to buy and sell luxury watches.
- Designed the microservices architecture, leveraging microservices for separate business functions, an API gateway for authentication and request routing, and RabbitMQ brokers for async task execution.
- Utilized React for client application, Express.js for service request routing, Flask for API framework, MySQL / Redis for data storage, and RabbitMQ for microservice communication.
